## F21 and F22 correction evidence

- Problem. Gerrit patchset 1 passed most Linux coverage but failed five macOS Python 3.13 preflight tests. Bash 3.2 rejected associative arrays before the field probe reached preflight. The review bot also found probe calls to module members that the Jira adapter does not expose.
- Proven root cause. Both scripts checked only that the adapter package imported. This allowed missing callables to survive preflight. The validation script and field script also invoked operations through the wrong owner. The field script used Bash syntax unavailable in the supported macOS shell.
- Proof. The adapter implementation exposes update_issue and transition_issue as module functions. AcliClient owns the other operations used by these probes. A process test with an executed fake adapter reached the ticket boundary with a complete adapter and failed before that boundary when each required operation was omitted. A Bash 3.2 run with probe opt-in and missing Jira configuration reached the JIRA_URL error instead of failing during shell parsing.
- Test integrity. The final oracle covers all nineteen required operations across both ownership forms. It was RED against the original import-only preflight for every omitted operation. It was GREEN after restoration. Removing one capability check returned it to RED. The oracle asserts exit 2, the named operation, no ticket event, and no instrumented Jira mutation event. A separate domain assessment approved the final contract coverage.
- Fix. Both preflights now validate their complete callable surfaces. Probe calls use module functions or AcliClient according to ownership. The field matrix uses indexed Bash arrays with newest-to-oldest lookup, preserving last-write-wins reporting. JIRA_PROJECT remains mandatory and no fallback project exists. The probe README documents callable validation.
- Verification. All nine focused tests pass on current origin/main. Lint, type checking, ShellCheck, Bash syntax, Bash 3.2 syntax, whitespace validation, and commit ticket verification pass. The full suite recorded 16,761 passes, 64 skips, and 298 deselections. One unrelated isolation fixture timed out while reading HEAD after five seconds under concurrent host load. The affected test body did not start. Five direct HEAD reads then completed in under one hundredth of a second, and the affected test passed in isolation.
- Gerrit. Commit eba7d50dc49518913abfc0cfb7ac8d1a27073610 preserves Change-Id I57fd814ce6b651813e172c249e5c9539329ae224 and the canonical ticket trailer. It is ready for one replacement patchset.
